summary: Home Manager can install the daily evidence-GC timer on a designated Linux host. New installations and the standalone wrapper default to a reviewable dry run; applying collection requires an explicit mode change.

replay.detail: Evidence signatures, records and verification policy are unchanged.

schema.detail: Adds services.smalltalk.evidenceGc.enable and dryRun Home Manager options.

rules.detail: Existing liveness-aware retention is unchanged. The managed applying service requires the signed-log wrapper and signer configuration.

compatibility.detail: Existing manual wrapper invocations must pass --apply to continue deleting. Without it they only write plans and summaries.

downtime.detail: No daemon restart or data-format migration is required.

manual.detail: Enable the timer on one designated host with dryRun = true, inspect its plan, and obtain approval before setting dryRun = false. Configure the existing signed-log publisher first so GC lines publish before deletion.

recovery.detail: Stop any applying service, then restore dryRun = true or disable the timer. Preserve pending-plan.json and signed-log state. Mode rollback does not restore already deleted refs.
